mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_device_session ( session_id, subject_type, subject_id, tenant_id, organization_id, app_code, token_digest, device_id_hash, device_type, device_name, login_method, login_ip_masked, login_time, last_active_time, idle_expires_at, absolute_expires_at, status, snapshot_version, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{tenantId}, #{organizationId}, #{appCode}, #{tokenDigest}, #{deviceIdHash}, #{deviceType}, #{deviceName}, #{loginMethod}, #{loginIpMasked}, #{loginTime}, #{lastActiveTime}, #{idleExpiresAt}, #{absoluteExpiresAt}, #{status}, #{snapshotVersion}, #{subjectId}, #{subjectId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, subject_type, subject_id, tenant_id, organization_id, app_code, token_digest, device_id_hash, device_type, device_name, login_method, login_ip_masked, login_time, last_active_time, idle_expires_at, absolute_expires_at, status, snapshot_version, version FROM public.auth_device_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_device_session SET status = 'LOGGED_OUT', updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.auth_device_session SET status = 'INVALIDATED', updated_by = #{subjectId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_deleted = false
